evidenceNotes: The current environment completed runtime publication, a production-authority seal and the continuity-system design phase.
One automatic context compaction was observed; no repeated engineering mistake or stale-authority correction was observed.
Official usage guidance says model, context, reasoning, tools, retrieval and caching affect consumption, so prompt length alone is not a reliable usage estimate.

The first combined local validation wrapper was blocked before test execution by the Work approval layer with network approval cancelled; no green or red product result was inferred, and exact owners were rerun directly.

The first focused continuity contract found that the golden policy referenced the underscored filename but not the system's human-readable name. The documentation heading was corrected; no scoring or product-runtime behavior changed.

The first JSON assessment exposed a Git porcelain parser defect that removed the first character of the first changed filename because generic trimming stripped the leading status column. Raw status output now preserves columns and a focused regression scenario protects the correction.
Inspection of the parser correction found a duplicate local declaration introduced during the edit. It was removed before rerunning syntax or contracts and never formed a candidate commit.

After all corrections, continuity validation, focused scenario contracts, all 29 repository contract files, the complete JavaScript/CJS/MJS syntax scan, git diff checking and the unchanged website-runtime boundary passed.
